protocol.generator_prompt: training-matched is_coconut=True with six latent slots
protocol.intervention: generator baseline h_T + s * unit-normalized three-seed policy ensemble
protocol.inverse_mapping: Adam optimization of only the six latent-slot embeddings to the target h_T
protocol.selection: held-out h_test pairs: Tanimoto >= 0.6, |target_delta| >= 1; one target per source with |target_delta| closest to 2; canonically sorted sources, uniformly subsampled
protocol.learned_oracle: MAE-1.1 text-query PkaHead; not an external predictor or experimental measurement
